lead: A case counts what a callback did through a captured *object*, since a closure captures by value and there is no `use (&$n)`.
body: `rule:types/implicit-capture` still shares an object at file scope: `final class Seen { public int $calls = 0; }`, `var $t = new Seen();`, then `fn (Core\Regex\Match $m): string => { $t->calls = $t->calls + 1; return "X"; }` handed to `Core\Regex::replaceWith`. A block-bodied `fn` declares its return type, and there is no `++` or `+=`.
